pages.text: $(l)Mekanism$() is a large tech mod built around multiplying your ores: each processing tier adds machines and chemicals that turn one ore into more ingots, up to five.$(br2)It also brings its own alloys, reactors and antimatter, most made in custom machines no crafting recipe describes.

$(l)Tier 2$(): fluorite and its ores at 10 FU.$(br2)$(l)Tier 3$(): uranium 25, steel 25, bronze 22, infused alloy 12.$(br2)$(l)Tier 4$(): refined glowstone 35.$(br2)$(l)Tier 5$(): refined obsidian 60, reinforced alloy 70.
pages.title: 14 pinned values

pages.text: $(l)Tier 6$(): atomic alloy at 130 FU.$(br2)$(l)Tier 8$(): an $(l)antimatter pellet$() at 600, one of only two Tier 8 materials MC3DPrint knows about. It needs an antimatter plant, which is roughly where the mod ends, so it is priced to match.
